Just picked up this bad boy, waiting for the new grip and heading to the range!

Mizuno JPX850 3 wood.

I hit several on the monitor, and this was the most consistent by far. It's a bit heavier than the Calloway for example. I can't wait to get it out and take it for a spin.

So I've played one round with it and a couple Range sessions. It's adjustable with the Quick Switch system, and I am running it at 16 degrees, as opposed to the stock 15, which still might be carrying a bit too far. It can go to 17 if needed.

Overall it's been great so far off a tee, I use it almost a short driver at my home course. Off the ground I find it forgiving on thin shots, with lots of speed off the club face.

It's the prettiest club in my bag by far, that blue is sexy in person on a sunny day.

Anyone shopping for a fairway wood should give this club a try. YMMV of course.
